note: Aggregate manifest for the RekalBench rung-1 run cited in docs/research/paper/rekal-paper.typ. Aggregates only: no session content, no commit messages, no paths outside this repo. Regenerate with scripts/bench (see DATA-RUN.md).
scope: rung-1 retrievability + judge-free drill-cost proxy; judged rungs, scale sweep, and the wiki gate are future work

systems.b1: grep-rank over raw transcript JSONL (non-agentic DCI proxy); transcript-UUID->ULID sidmap join
systems.b5: Rekal full hybrid (default weights + steering/summary boost + subagent down-weight)

rung1_test_split.ci_note: pooled_mrr values are [mean, ci_lo, ci_hi] from 1000-resample bootstrap over queries; other metrics are point estimates

drill_proxy_t1_paired.note: context-assembly cost + gold-term coverage, not answer quality; used only for the ~1,500-token / 69%-coverage figure in the paper

findings.prediction_holds: B5 hybrid pooled MRR 0.187 vs B1 grep-rank 0.005, non-overlapping bootstrap CIs (a floor: raw transcripts are adversarial retrieval material)
findings.composition: hybrid's gain over BM25-only (B3) is small and CIs overlap pooled; separation is a T1 provenance effect (0.301 vs 0.248), level on T2 (0.124 vs 0.130)

limitations.single_corpus: one operator, one primary repo; case study until replicated (the harness is public and runs on any Rekal store)
limitations.b1_is_non_agentic: grep-rank is a term-frequency ranker, not an agent driving rg; the agentic-DCI comparison is a judged-rung, not run here
limitations.t3_empty: single-branch corpus yields no dead-end labels
